conceptual_change: Implement a volatility-gate filter that restricts order execution to periods where the current ATR(14) exceeds 150% of the 20-period SMA of the ATR(14) to mitigate noise-driven false breakouts.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous failure was due to an unexecutable hypothesis; this revision formalizes the implementation requirement as an explicit conditional execution rule to filter signal generation based on historical volatility metrics.
